body.en: A linear economy takes, makes, and throws away. A circular economy keeps materials in use for as long as possible. Sort each practice into the economy it belongs to.

items.label: Buying single-use plastic packaging and discarding it after one use
Repairing a broken appliance instead of replacing it
Sending unsorted waste straight to a landfill
Refilling a container at a bulk goods station
Buying cheap clothing designed to be discarded within a season
Reselling or donating used goods instead of discarding them
